name: audit-fixture-patches
_comment: Tests lpm's patch system under both linker modes. The contract: a patch declared in `lpm.patchedDependencies` is applied to every physical destination of the target package — `apply_patches_for_install` in install.rs filters `link_result.materialized` to find each layout shape (isolated wrapper, hoisted root, hoisted-nested fallback). Risk: hoisted materialized-package lists are computed differently than isolated lists, so patches that work in isolated might not find their target in hoisted's flat layout. The patch appends a sentinel function (`lpmPatchProof()`) to ms@2.1.3's index.js; the smoke verifies the function is present and returns its expected string from a require()'d ms instance under both modes.
